profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aetna, a CVS Health Company
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the higher education industry. Skilled in JAVA, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and the software development cycle. Strong engineering professional with a Master’s Degree focused in Computer Software Engineering from The University of Texas at El Paso.
